subject: Support & SLA options for Clearwave deployment
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Long <sara@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Support & SLA options for Clearwave deployment

Sara —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. As promised, attached is a compact set of SLA / premium support options so your procurement team can evaluate tradeoffs quickly. High level options (monthly billing, USD):

- Standard: 99.9% uptime, P1 acknowledgment within 1 hour (business hours M-F), P2 within 4 hours. Standard support hours (8x5) with email + ticketing response. No retainer required. Estimated add-on: $6k/mo.

- Premium: 99.95% uptime, P1 acknowledgement within 30 minutes (24x7), P2 within 2 hours. 24x7 escalation coverage and named on-call rotation. Recommended for production-facing inference (spiky traffic). Retainer: $12k/mo. Estimated add-on: $18k/mo.

- Premium Plus: 99.995% uptime, P1 onsite/zoom response within 15 minutes (24x7 on-call), proactive health checks, weekly executive sync. Includes dedicated escalation engineer for the initial 90 days. Retainer: $25k/mo. Estimated add-on: $38k/mo.

We include a credits schedule in the appendix (see SLA_Appendix_v1.pdf) and a short worksheet that maps expected monthly spend to retainer discounts (SLA_Prices_v1.xlsx). A few notes/questions for you before we firm numbers:

1) Do you need the 24x7 engineering rota to include a named Redwood escalation owner (for faster paging)?
2) Is Clearwave planning a 12-mo reserved capacity commit or month-to-month? We can offer a 10-15% retainer discount for an annual commitment.
3) Are there any regulatory requirements (SOC2/PCI) that drive additional logging / audit retention?

If you’d like, Rishi can propose a variant with a reduced onboarding fee and a sample escalation roster we typically use.

Next steps: I can lock a short-term pricing hold through Friday if that helps procurement.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA_Prices_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: SLA_Appendix_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sara Long <sara@clearwave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wei <tom.wei@clearwave.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Support & SLA options for Clearwave deployment

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear breakdown — helpful. A few quick items from procurement/ops after reviewing with Tom:

- We like the Premium tier conceptally but need a tighter P1 SLA: can you get to 15 minutes for P1 acknowledgement and initial mitigation steps? The environment will host real-time scoring for a customer-facing feature; even short blips are visible.
- The retainer at $12k/mo is outside our planned budget. What flexibility exists for a blended option (e.g., Premium feature set but priced lower if we accept a higher P2 window)?
- We need the credits formula spelled out (e.g., how many days/hours of downtime map to what % credit). Tom will need that for their internal finance model.
- On escalation: we require a named escalation contact and a documented on-call roster that shows primary/secondary. Can Redwood provide an example roster and confirm rotation cadence?

Procurement timeline: we’re targeting a signed SOW by end of March, purchase order by mid-April.

Can Rishi or Stephanie propose a tightened Premium variant and an example credits calc? Also, are you able to share the DocuSign template so legal can pre-check?

Appreciate it —
Sara
VP, Product Ops — Clearwave Analytics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Long <sara@clearwave.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:33:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Support & SLA options for Clearwave deployment

Sara / Kimberly —

Looping in a tightened proposal and an example escalation roster. Quick summary of what we can do without impacting capacity planning:

- Premium+ Variant (proposed): 99.995% target uptime, P1 initial response & mitigation within 15 minutes (24x7), P2 within 1 hour. Includes a named Redwood escalation owner and a documented on-call rotation (primary/secondary) for the life of the SOW.
- Cost delta: Premium+ adds ~20% to the Premium retainer. With a 12-month reserved capacity commit we can reduce the delta to ~8% and waive the one-time onboarding fee ($10k).

Credits model (simple, example):
- Tier baseline: 99.95% => monthly credit = 10% of that month’s invoice if total monthly downtime > 2 hours.
- Premium+: 99.995% => monthly credit = 25% of that month’s invoice if downtime between 15 and 60 minutes; 50% if downtime between 60 and 180 minutes; 100% if downtime exceeds 180 minutes.

Example calc: if Clearwave is on Premium+ (monthly invoice $50,000) and observed downtime in a calendar month = 45 minutes, then credit = 25% -> $12,500 applied to next invoice.

Attached is a sample escalation roster (escalation_roster_example.csv) — we typically show primary (on-call) + secondary (backup) + regional escalation lead. We can redact names for the public doc and provide a final roster when the SOW is executed.

Open items I need from you:
1) Confirm whether your legal wants the DocuSign template now or after commercial terms.
2) Confirm expected monthly spend range (so we can map exact retainer discount).

If this looks close, Kimberly can prepare a Final SLA Delta (one-page change summary) and we’ll share a DocuSign pre-fill.

- Rishi
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: escalation_roster_example.csv (csv)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Long <sara@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Support & SLA options for Clearwave deployment

Sara —

Thanks — this is helpful and aligned with what Rishi proposed. A few final commercial points I can offer to help close the PO:

- If Clearwave signs a 12-month reserved capacity agreement we will:
  * Offer an 8% reduction on Premium+ retainer pricing.
  * Waive the $10k onboarding fee.
  * Provide a 30-day price hold after SOW signature.

- Finalized credits language we will put in SOW (example clause):
  "If Redwood fails to meet the monthly uptime target, Customer shall be eligible for service credits as follows: for downtime > 15 and <= 60 minutes, a credit equal to 25% of the monthly service fee; for downtime > 60 and <= 180 minutes, a credit equal to 50% of the monthly service fee; for downtime > 180 minutes, a credit equal to 100% of the monthly service fee. Credits are exclusive of any other remedies and are Redwood’s sole financial liability for downtime."

- On escalation roster: we can provide a redacted roster on signature and a full on-call calendar (with pager windows) after the kickoff meeting. The named escalation owner will be reachable via phone and Slack and will act as your escalation liaison during incidents.

Next steps: if you confirm the monthly spend band (ballpark $30k-$60k), I’ll send a one-page Final_SLA_Delta and pre-fill DocuSign for your legal. If Tom prefers to run the credit calc internally I’m happy to join a 30-minute call with procurement next week.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Final_SLA_Delta.pdf (pdf)]
